query:
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  incumbent = 'John Cornyn',
  incumbent_party = 'R',
  incumbent_retiring = 0,
  notes = 'Ken Paxton (Republican) won the May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff over incumbent John Cornyn, who was seeking re-election. Paxton, the former Texas Attorney General and Trump-endorsed candidate, is now the Republican nominee. He faces Democrat James Talarico in the November 3, 2026 general election. Rated Likely R (Cook Political Report / Inside Elections / Sabato\'s Crystal Ball). Election day: November 3, 2026.'
WHERE id = 30;
